notes.title: Release Date Announcement and new Publisher
notes.notes:
[p]Hi wishlisters and community members![/p][h3]
RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
[/h3][p]Thanks to all of you for so patiently waiting for the next news about Darkenstein 3D. 
The demo has been doing the rounds, and since its release, much has improved. 
The game is now finished, and it is ready to launch. [/p][h3]
[i]The game will be available FOR FREE, no tricks, on [/i][/h3][h2][b]October the 21st[/b][/h2][h3][i]for all of you to go into it and start your nazi killing campaign![/i][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43246048/eb4608bc81b125d451202d5f96b4a0ec6820746c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A NEW PATH[/h3][p][/p][p][b]But there is more good news, the PC version of the game will be published by the legendary Microprose.[/b]

What does this mean for the game?
The game will get better!

We are now looking at a longer-lived game, with more content to come.
DLCs will *not* be bite-sized and we will *not* nickel and dime you.

A first, smaller, expansion will be released so that you can, if you want, support the dev (me! hah), since the game is free.

After that, I’ll keep building longer story expansions, with (hopefully) a few more people joining the project. These DLCs will carry the story of the Hobo Guy and Gunther into new chapters for you to experience.


[b]I am truly looking forward to all of you getting your hands on the final game, and I thank everyone again who has been waiting for such a long time.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Now is the time.
It’s coming.[/h3][h3]
[b]Get Psyched![/b][/h3][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🔔 Darkenstein 3-D Alpha Playtest Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone—the game is ready for a big test, and I’d love your help me with the final touches to the game and shaping the final boss fight. Want in on the action? 

[i]This PlayTest will run for a couple weeks, so you can come over after you're done with Doom. ;)[/i]


🔹 [b]What You’ll Play[/b]
[u]12 polished levels[/u]—retro corridors, castle ruins, snow, deserts and more.
[u]Boss arena preview[/u]—reach the fight setup, experiment with early mechanics, then cliff-hanger!

🎯 [b]Your Mission[/b]
[u]Hop into Discord[/u] to find out more about the playtest and download the alpha build (link below).
[u]Drop feedback[/u]: help me make the game better, suggest boss-fight ideas, or report bugs.
Hang out with the dev and other testers—your voice shapes the final release!

🔗 [b]How to:[/b]
👉 [u]Join my Discord[/u] and grab the build today!
Discord Server: https://discord.gg/QXznQCvqPu


And of course,
GL & HF!

notes.title: Old demo OUT -> New demo IN !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce a [b]major update to Darkenstein 3-D's demo[/b]! After months of development and invaluable feedback from you all, here I come with an enhanced version that I can't wait for you to try.

This new demo is called Winter Demo for a reason, however. I've decided that level 5 was good to show as a middle point between early and late game. But, why can't we have it all? 
So, in this demo, [b]you can now play the first level of the game, and also level 9![/b]

Some improvements include enhanced enemy behaviors, reloads for some of the weapons, a lot of new enemy types, better UI , refined combat mechanics, and a lot more polish! I've also squashed several bugs that players reported, making the overall experience more stable.

[i]The original demo will remain available on Itch.io[/i] for those who want to compare or prefer it, but I strongly recommend checking out the new version. I will most likely take the level 5 demo down at some point, so catch it now if you want it!

Cheers everyone, and get psyched!
Roger
